senses.gloss:
धुत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, agitated, moved
quickly to and fro; abandoned, deserted, left.
—धुत-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्, purified from sin.

धूत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, shaken off, removed,
agitated; fanned, rinsed, cleansed (in this sense said
to be an old form for धौत, q. v.); deserted, aban-
doned; reproached, reviled; judged, discriminated;
(अम्), n. (?), good behaviour; (आ), f. a wife.
—धूत-
कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose sins are shaken
off, free from sin, pure.
—धूत-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्,
one who has shaken off his sins; removing or
destroying sin; (आ), f., N. of a river; of the daughter
of the ascetic Veda-śiras.
—धूतपाप-तीर्थ, अम्,
n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—धूतपापेश्वर-तीर्थ (˚प-
ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.
—धूत-
पाप्मन्, आ, आ, अ, = धूत-पाप, q. v.

धूत्वा, ind. having shaken or shaken off; having
agitated.
